frequency_question: How often does a proposed high-impact fee regulation reach final publication within one year of initiation?
membership_rule: Includes all DHS/USCIS proposed rules involving significant fee adjustments (>50% increase or novel high-value structures) published in the Federal Register since 2009. Excludes minor administrative adjustments.

cases.name: Public Charge Ground of Inadmissibility Rule

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named; all identified major fee and immigration-related high-impact rules in this category completed final publication within the one-year window.
known_gaps: Judicial stays sometimes delay implementation dates, but technical final publication in the Federal Register almost always occurs once initiated by an administration prioritizing the rule.
validity_reason: Base rate tied to standard administrative procedure timelines and executive branch rule-making behavior, valid for the duration of the current presidential term.
